content.comment_body: Here is a simplified version of an issue I encounter occasionally. I use counters for display times (6 seconds) and input hold times (5 seconds), since they're needed in multiple parts of my designs. For connection B272 to B021, and its related counter value in B021, everything is visible; but between B273 and B259, even though the counter value (500) is correctly set, no connection is shown. This makes editing those connections difficult. In the complete design, the invisible connection has the same issue in many locations—the counter value is correct, but there's no visible sign of the connection.

I am sharing another .lsc file which leads to a NullPointerException in [product_name] [version_no]. If you load this file and expand the parameter boxes, when expanding the second one, a Java Exception error appears. This prevents the connection from being displayed and, at times, even causes the software to forget the configured unit. For example, an Off delay that was set in seconds opens by default in milliseconds, even though it was saved in seconds.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report ongoing issues with missing visual connections in the [product_name] [version_no] interface and experience application crashes (NullPointerException) when working with certain files. These problems complicate editing and reviewing designs, impacting workflow efficiency. Additionally, settings such as time units are not consistently preserved, leading to confusion and reduced usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect all project connections in [product_name] [version_no] to be visible and editable at all times, and for the software to consistently save and restore parameter configurations, including units, after files are reopened.
